cim: HFTP to host Hospitality AI Event in Dallas area in 2027
cim_eredeti: HFTP to host Hospitality AI Event in Dallas area in 2027
szoveg_eredeti:
Hospitality Financial and Technology Professionals (HFTP) will host a two-day event focused on artificial intelligence in hospitality in the greater Dallas area.

The event—scheduled to take place on Feb. 2-3, and coordinated by HFTP’s AI Collective—will bring together members of the group and industry experts to discuss AI applications in hospitality operations, finance and technology, as well as governance and risk.

Sessions will address AI governance, intellectual property, foundational concepts and security risks. The program also will include updates from AI Collective members and a roundtable focused on sharing experiences and approaches to AI adoption.

“AI is reshaping how hospitality businesses operate, from the back office to the guest experience. Our members need clear, trusted information to use these tools wisely and securely,” HFTP CEO Frank Wolfe said in a statement. “The AI Collective gives our community a place to learn, ask tough questions and lead the way forward.”

“This event is a chance to move past the headlines and talk honestly about what AI means for our industry,” added Shannon McCallum, AI Collective co-chair and RVP North America Applications Gaming at Oracle.”
